up: Retrieve the compound ChEMBL ID, preferred name, activity type, standard value, and standard units for all exact activity measurements from assay CHEMBL1613992. sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, a.standard_type, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613992' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
